metadata.name: Audio Tools Unit Test Suite
metadata.description: Comprehensive test of all audio production tools: edit_audio, create_drum, midi_mp3, tts, and voice_clone
metadata.author: automated-developer

goals.objective: Verify edit_audio tool is operational by checking backend availability

success: edit_audio check_backends action returns successfully
Response indicates whether ffmpeg is available
Response includes list of supported formats
acceptance: Tool responds without throwing an error

constraints: Record the ffmpeg availability status in notepad for other tests

goals.objective: Verify create_drum tool by listing available TR-808 samples

success: create_drum list_samples action returns all 16 TR-808 sounds
Each sample has code, name, category, and aliases
Categories include kicks, snares, hihats, toms, congas, percussion, cymbals
acceptance: BD (kick), SD (snare), CH (closed hihat), OH (open hihat) are present

constraints: Save sample list to notepad for reference

goals.objective: Verify create_drum preset patterns are available

success: create_drum list_presets action returns genre presets
Presets include basic_rock, four_on_floor, boom_bap, trap, dnb
Each preset has name, description, and BPM
acceptance: Each preset has a valid BPM between 60 and 200

goals.objective: Retrieve a specific drum preset pattern for inspection

success: get_preset action returns the boom_bap preset
Preset includes the full pattern notation
Pattern contains BD, SD, and CH tracks
acceptance: Pattern string is valid and contains instrument codes
BPM is returned (should be 90 for boom_bap)

constraints: Use get_preset action with preset_name boom_bap

goals.objective: Render a drum pattern to audio file using ffmpeg

success: render_preset action generates a WAV audio file
Output file exists at the returned path
Duration matches expected length for pattern at given BPM
acceptance: Audio file is created without errors

constraints: Only run if ffmpeg is available (check notepad from test-edit-audio-backends)
Use four_on_floor preset at 128 BPM with 2 loops

success: midi_mp3 check_backends action returns successfully
Response indicates FluidSynth availability
Response shows MP3 encoder status (lame or ffmpeg)
list_instruments action returns all GM instruments
Instruments are numbered 0-127
Instruments are grouped by family (Piano, Strings, Brass, etc.)

goals.objective: Validate MIDI note DSL parsing without synthesis

success: validate_input action parses note sequence correctly
Reports note count, tempo, and duration
Validates without requiring FluidSynth
acceptance: Input 'tempo:120 C4:q D4:q E4:q F4:q G4:h' is valid

constraints: Test with a simple C major scale pattern

context.input_text: tempo:120 C4:q D4:q E4:q F4:q | G4:h A4:h | B4:q C5:q D5:q E5:q | F5:w

goals.objective: Synthesize a melody from note notation to audio

success: synthesize action generates audio file from notes
Output file exists at returned path
Duration matches expected length
acceptance: Audio file is created if FluidSynth available
Graceful error if FluidSynth not installed

constraints: Only run if FluidSynth is available (check notepad)
Keep melody short for quick synthesis

goals.objective: Verify TTS tool backend availability (Coqui TTS)

success: tts check_backends action returns successfully
Response indicates Coqui TTS CLI availability
Response shows GPU availability status
acceptance: Model cache directory path is reported

goals.objective: List supported languages for TTS synthesis

success: list_languages action returns common languages
English, Spanish, French, German, etc. are listed
Notes about Fairseq 1100+ language support included
acceptance: Language codes (en, es, fr) are provided

goals.objective: Get model recommendations for English TTS

success: recommend_model action returns suitable models
Recommendations are ranked by relevance
Each recommendation includes quality tier info
acceptance: At least one model recommended for English

success: voice_clone check_backends action returns successfully
Response indicates TTS and FFmpeg availability
XTTS and FreeVC model names reported

constraints: Record voice clone readiness in notepad

goals.objective: List available preset and cached speakers

success: list_speakers action returns XTTS preset speakers
Preset speakers include names like 'Ana Florence', 'Craig Gutsy'
Cached speaker count is reported

goals.objective: List XTTS supported languages for voice cloning

success: list_languages action returns XTTS language support
17 languages supported by XTTS v2
Language codes and names provided
acceptance: Languages include en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ru, zh-cn, ja, ko

goals.objective: Test audio editing by processing a generated drum file

success: Apply volume adjustment to the drum file
Apply fade in/out effects
Convert to MP3 format

constraints: Only run if drum file was generated (depends on test-create-drum-render-preset)
Use pipeline action to chain operations if possible

goals.objective: Compile test results into a summary report

success: Create a test summary in notepad
List all tools tested and their status
Note any missing dependencies
acceptance: Report includes pass/fail for each tool

constraints: Summarize results from all previous tests

requiredDependencies.ffmpeg: Required for edit_audio, create_drum, and MP3 encoding
requiredDependencies.coqui-tts: Required for tts and voice_clone (pip install TTS)

globalContext.notes: Tests are designed to gracefully handle missing dependencies. Backend check actions always work. Synthesis actions require their respective backends.
